text: G'day, I'm minding my granddaughter (9) tonight and I feel a bit silly messaging but her mum said to check. She's got a stiff neck, she can't put her chin down to look at her tummy, she says it won't go. And she hasn't done a wee since about lunchtime this arvo, so well over 12 hours now. Her eczema's playing up as well, dry itchy bits on her arms. She's wide awake though, chatting away to me and watching the telly, so she seems herself otherwise. Am I fussing over nothing?
